sloka: स तदा क्रियते सेतुर्वानरै र्घोरकर्मभिः ।दण्डनन्ये प्रगृह्णन्ति विचिन्वन्ति तथापरे ॥६-२२-६२॥।।
transliteration: sa tadā kriyate seturvānarai rghorakarmabhiḥ ।daṇḍananye pragṛhṇanti vicinvanti tathāpare ॥6-22-62॥।।

translations.english: Others held sticks and some held logs of wood and reeds following the command of Rama, hundreds of Vanaras who looked like clouds and mountain tops built the bridge.
